title: Umoja na Wingi wa Sentensi (Theme 4: Kazi mbalimbali)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the word the grammar point depends on (the person, the noun and its ngeli, one or many) before choosing the form.

floor.prerequisite: Names everyday things and people in Kiswahili.
floor.question: Hiki ni nini? (kiti)

representations: picture and word cards sorted by ngeli or person
colour matching of the parts that agree
a short passage on kazi mbalimbali using the words
steps: Ask: one or many? Which ngeli or person?
contexts: a game with real objects in class
talking with a parent at home

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child makes his own sentence with the form and reads it aloud.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hili ni la ngeli gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila ngeli ina wingi wake: kitabu - vitabu, mtoto - watoto. (Walimu wanafundisha.)
Sentensi nzima hubadilika: Vitabu vimeanguka. (Madaktari wanatibu wagonjwa.)
Baadhi ya nomino hazibadiliki, na baadhi hubadilika kwa njia yake. (Meno yanauma.)

misconceptions.ask: Nomino inabadilikaje ikiwa zaidi ya moja?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino hubadilika pia: vitabu viwili. (wapishi wawili)
